_comment: Scoped per-commit mutation gate (coding-standards §12.1/§12.5): mutate ONLY the load-bearing logic THIS change touched, not pre-existing code or DOM writers. Ranges: the four renderings this change implemented after CodeQL found them computed-and-discarded — knowledge.js stageMeta + the feel-dot ink + codeBlock's lang class (#164/#165/#155), interaction.js connItemHtml (#160), polling.js's offline degradation (#163), wiki.js buildEditorSetup (#174/#175). Earlier scopes (brain esc for #148-#151; trigram.js indexWords/uniqueWords for #153/#154; workflow_graph_lod.js wfgEdgeCoverage, coverage_model.js verdict logic, coverage_indicator.js gatherSources + fmtAge, renderer computeNeighborSet/linkTier, filters buildPredicate, wfgLodTier for issues #35/#36/#41) are unchanged by this diff; their mutation state is recorded in tests/js/MUTATION_NOTES.md.
_comment_vitest: related:false — source: stryker-mutator.io/docs/stryker-js/troubleshooting #vitest-failed-to-find-test-files-related-to-mutated-files. The suites load the browser IIFEs into a shared jsdom global instead of importing them, so Stryker 9's related-file tracing finds no tests.
